name: Hau song
summary: Hàu sống is raw oysters on Đầm Lập An. VietnamPlus says to eat them with lemon, or with soy sauce and wasabi, and says the Lang Co way differs without printing it. Nhân Dân says only hàu đá is farmed here, and that raw eating suits hàu sữa.
origin: Lang Co, on Đầm Lập An. VietnamPlus, 9 February 2016, and Nhân Dân, 5 July 2024. The two accounts of which oyster is eaten raw both stay.
howToEat: VietnamPlus describes lemon, or soy sauce and wasabi, then says the Lang Co way of eating raw oysters is different and does not print that difference.
Nhân Dân’s farmer says the lagoon raises hàu đá only. A cook in the same article says hàu sữa, not the rock oyster, suits raw eating. Both stay.
VietnamPlus printed about 60,000 VND a kilogram at one floating restaurant in 2016. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Đầm Lập An. VietnamPlus describes floating restaurants and does not name one to book.
seoTitle: Hau song in Lang Co — raw oysters
seoDescription: Hàu sống is raw oysters on Đầm Lập An. VietnamPlus and Nhân Dân disagree on hàu sữa and hàu đá. A current price is Check on arrival.
